name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Jana Nagyová
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to lift the legal protection that Jana Nagyová, a Czech member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Czech prosecutors accuse her of getting an EU grant for a company that was not entitled to it, by falsely claiming it was a small, independent business. The Prague High Court asked for this waiver so it can continue its appeal case against her. The protection is lifted only for this case.

- **What changes:** Czech courts can now prosecute Jana Nagyová in this fraud case.
- **Who it affects:** Jana Nagyová, a member of the European Parliament from the Czech Republic.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Czech court and to her.
